newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar slips in strong dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar slips in strong dollar demand.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly weaker at 475.50/476.50 per dollar on Tuesday, compared with 475.00/476.00 per dollar on Monday as strong dollar demand met little resistance from the Central Bank, brokers said.
Traders said foreign currency buying in the morning sent was met by the Central bank, but continued demand in the afternoon was not covered forcing the exchange rate to rise.
Traders expected the exchange rate to remain little changed or slightly lower on Wednesday as the Central Bank sought to control the bolivar's depreciation.
